canonical_name: Mt. Columbia - East Ridge via Three Elk Creek
scope_note: Class 2 and ordinal risks are analyst estimates from grassy ridge, mostly stable talus, steep access slopes, creek crossings, disappearing trail and bushwhacking described in the summer reports. Geometry uses the 2013 Three Elk trailhead East Ridge ascent only; the emergency descent is excluded. It does not include the 2023 Harvard Lakes starting variant. Recorded summit elevation is anomalously low despite coordinates within 15 m of the published summit; no elevation correction is invented.
User request retained for review; exact itinerary and claimed Class 4 remain unverified. Not a verified Buckskin traverse substitution.

canonical_name: Mt. Princeton - Southwest Ridge via Grouse Canyon
scope_note: Grade 3 selects the short direct ridge pitch explicitly climbed in report 3363 rather than silently taking the Class 2+ bypass. Ordinal risks are analyst estimates from exposed short ridge pitch, loose scree/talus, unmarked trail junctions/bushwhacking and sustained 5000+ ft ascent. GPX upload Princeton - Grouse Canyon by butcher213, climbed July 3, 2021, reaches summit and returns to starting area. Retain separate segments; published 2007 totals are a separate observation.
